procedure.method: This fresh independent session read only the supplied pinned inputs. The packet declares zero source assets and zero protected-layout manifests, so no source image opens or protected-layout reads were applicable. All five pinned native-evidence manifests were read, without following their embedded producer paths. All 15 exact poster files were then actually opened and visually inspected via functions.exec/tools.view_image with detail:'original', emitted as images in sequence M1 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M2 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M3 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M4 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M5 native, usage720, thumbnail320. Only after the fifteenth view did the first copy-reading/transcription stage and all judgments/scores begin, using those displayed pixels. The first 60 readings were retained untouched in session memory; none was filled from packet copy. No ambiguity-triggered revisits were needed or performed. Hash, byte, dimension and RGB opacity checks were separate read-only checks, not claims of semantic viewing. Native dimensions are 1672×940 for M1 and 1672×941 for M2–M5: 16:9 passes only nearest-integer-single-edge height rounding at ±0.5 px, not exact native equality. Usage720 is 720×405 and thumbnail320 is 320×180 for every member. No images were generated/edited, no peer/producer records or unlisted paths were opened, no agents spawned/resumed/forked, and no session/tool-event identity is invented.
